value.rationale: The physical motivation is the known puzzling contrast between lambda-blind mean dissipation and lambda-dependent enhanced diffusion. This result upgrades it to total loss of switching-rate identifiability from every medium-entropy time statistic, while revealing an explicit non-Gaussian full counting statistics. This is a structural separation with measurable interpretive consequences, not a routine average or arbitrary parameter sample.
